notes.title: User Feedback Update - Update Notes 22/05
notes.notes:
Firstly, thank you to everyone who's purchased, playtested and wishlisted the game, it's all come together to create what we would deem a very successful launch!

We've seen people across various countries joining servers and fishing with us to create a really enjoyable experience.

After listening to your feedback, we've made some small changes:

[list]
[*] [b] Help Handling Your Rod (Adding A Tutorial)[/b]: We fear that some people may unclear on how the game actually works, so we've added a launch tutorial.
[*] [b]Master Baiting (Bait Rebalance)[/b]: This will drastically improve the rate at which you get a bite from the various objects and fish in Strange Shores
[*] [b] It's Fishing Not Phishing (Anti-Virus False Positive Fix)[/b]: We've had reports that some anti-virus software such as McAfee was detecting the game as a virus; this should be resolved now (however, Antiy-AVL is still unhappy with us!)
[/list]

What else are we working on!

While we've already made some improvements, over the coming weeks we will:

[list]
[*] Bring AFK to multiplayer
[*] Continue to remedy anti-virus false positives
[*] Monitor the status of ongoing server exit bug and provide a fix when available
[/list]

We really appreciate those of you who have supported us in development and launching Strange Shores and we will continue to work on the game until we are satisfied it is the best it can be!

Best Fishes,
Banana Jam Games
